policy: Approximate CET-6-reader relevance; not official word-list membership.

cases.expectedBehavior: 本机拒绝空选区，不发送 AI 请求。

cases.source: I like to read books after school.
cases.expectedBehavior: 生词应为空或极克制，不列 like/read/books/school 普通义。
必须包含 happy 的词性与中文义；缺少语境时不编造。
解释 scrutinized，保留原词形；不只返回 scrutinize。

cases.source: The scientist meticulously scrutinized the anomalous results before drawing a tentative conclusion.
cases.expectedBehavior: 优先有价值的修饰词、学术动作与异常/暂定语义，略过普通基础词。

cases.source: The committee tabled the proposal until next month.
cases.expectedBehavior: 考虑 tabled 的延期审议语境义；如指出地区义差异应简短，不误译为桌子。

cases.source: Despite the setback, she persevered and eventually turned the tide in her favor.
cases.expectedBehavior: 优先 setback/persevered 等，turn the tide 作为固定表达；不把任意相邻词组凑成表达。

cases.source: The catalyst accelerated the reaction without being consumed.
cases.expectedBehavior: 催化剂、反应与未被消耗的科学含义准确；不根据普通字面义误译 consumed。

cases.source: The evidence is insufficient to substantiate the allegation.
cases.expectedBehavior: 保留证据不足、不能证实的意思；优先 substantiate/allegation。

cases.source: a substantial discrepancy between the estimates
cases.expectedBehavior: 按短语解释，不虚构主语或事件；词性符合原文。
